sectionTwo.heading: LMI’s Assured Fleet Network
sectionTwo.description: Fleet availability is where reliable transportation starts. This is how we run it.

cards.heading: Our tanker fleet
paragraphs: Tankers for petroleum and chemical cargo, inspected before every dispatch and equipped with fire-safety and protective equipment on board.
[Confirm: number, types and capacities of tankers]

cards.heading: Verified trucks and drivers
paragraphs: A network of verified trucks and drivers for dry, containerized, flatbed and project cargo, available exactly when required.
[Confirm: how vehicles and drivers are verified]

cards.heading: Coordinated from Karachi
paragraphs: Vehicles are assigned, dispatched and coordinated from our Karachi base, where our 10-acre facility supports operations.

sectionFour.heading: Right Vehicle, Every Time
sectionFour.description: We do not send whichever truck happens to be free. The cargo decides the equipment, so what you ship arrives in a vehicle built to carry it.

sectionFive.heading: From Cargo Details to Dispatch
sectionFive.description: Every movement starts with the cargo, not the truck. We gather the details that decide the equipment, then check the vehicle and driver before anything leaves, so the cargo arrives safely and on schedule.

steps.heading: Review the cargo
steps.description: We confirm the product, weight, dimensions and how it is loaded and unloaded.

steps.heading: Select equipment
steps.description: The vehicle type is matched to the cargo, route and any site requirements.

steps.heading: Confirm readiness
steps.description: Vehicle, driver and safety equipment are inspected before dispatch.

steps.heading: Dispatch
steps.description: Cargo is loaded, secured and sent on its way, with the driver briefed on the route.

steps.heading: Deliver
steps.description: Arrival and unloading are coordinated with the receiving site.

readiness.heading: Vehicle readiness.
readiness.description: Every vehicle is inspected and safety-checked before dispatch.

items.question: What is an assured fleet network?
items.answer: A network of verified trucks and drivers that LMI coordinates so a suitable vehicle is available exactly when required.

items.question: How do you choose the right vehicle?
items.answer: We review the cargo type, weight, dimensions, loading method and route before assigning equipment.

items.question: Are vehicles checked before dispatch?
items.answer: Yes. Every vehicle is inspected and safety-checked before it leaves.

items.question: Can you supply tankers for petroleum and chemicals?
items.answer: Yes. Our tanker fleet handles petroleum products and, with suitable equipment, chemical and liquid cargo.

sectionEight.heading: What does your cargo need?
sectionEight.description: Tell us about your cargo, pickup point and destination.
